summary.intent: Run the full GSD pipeline for phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core): plan the phase, execute all plans across 4 waves, then ship via PR.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully — 7 plans across 4 waves, plan-checker passed on iteration 2 (7/7 requirements, 10/10 decisions covered). Execution was initiated and Wave 1 plan 63-01 was dispatched when the transcript ended; execution and /ship-phase were not yet complete.

repo: Phase 63 builds: navigation walk (63-01), grant/invite crypto (63-02), rotation engine with 4 named Phase-64 seams (63-03), folder add/move mutations (63-04), hasCoveringGrant + zero-rotation invariant + barrel (63-03/05), deletion of reWrapForRecipients + rewire sdk add-item (63-06), one live sdk-e2e round-trip (63-07).
GSD commit helper consistently emits false-negatives — commits land successfully but the helper reports failure; must verify via `git log` rather than trusting helper output.
Worktrees are unsafe in this repo due to node_modules and api:generate leaks; the planner explicitly recommended sequential execution in the main tree.
Plans 63-01 and 63-04 share `folder.test.ts`, creating cross-plan coupling that reinforces the sequential-over-parallel execution choice.
commit.gpgsign was already set to false locally; no biometric-prompt risk during AFK execution.
API health endpoint is at `http://localhost:3000/health`; CI polls it with `curl -fsS` in a bounded loop — the canonical pattern for startup waits.
Drift gate (stale codebase map) is non-blocking at plan time; CONTEXT.md + RESEARCH.md carry precise current implementation-site references.

code.finding: Used fragile `sleep 12` for API startup delay; replaced with bounded health-poll loop mirroring CI's `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` pattern.

workflow: GSD plan-phase pipeline order: research → VALIDATION.md stub → drift/UI gates → pattern-mapper → planner → plan-checker → iterate on findings → post-verification state update.
Plan-checker requires RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` section to carry `(RESOLVED)` markers on answered questions — omitting them triggers a blocker even when answers are substantively present.
VALIDATION.md is written as a template stub at step 5.5 (pre-planner) and must be filled with the per-task verification map after plans are written; leaving it as template triggers a checker warning.
Checker-found issues that are deterministic formatting/tracking fixes (not design flaws) can be applied directly by the orchestrator without re-spawning the planner, saving a full planner round-trip.

Pre-execution gates to run before wave dispatch: execute:pre hooks, safe-resume (no partial commits), no .continue-here.md sentinel, sync-chain flag, branch identity confirmation, STATE phase-start mark.
Sequential executor mode (no worktrees) is the safe default for AFK runs with cross-plan file coupling.

friction: GSD commit helper false-negatives on every commit required manual `git log` verification after each commit step — added friction throughout both planning and execution.
Plan-checker iteration 1 returned 1 blocker + 2 warnings, requiring a full fix-and-recheck cycle before execution could start.
API-SURFACE regeneration returned 0 symbols for this phase, making the intel gate a no-op but still consuming a step.
Drift gate flagged a stale codebase map on every run, adding noise; map was non-blocking but required an explicit decision to skip refresh each time.
